author: DrSwing
text:
Hi rcmacf, it sounds to me like you may just need to redefine your swing. There are plenty of good coaches here on RTM to help, if you would like to throw up a few swing examples. Then maybe with a re-jigged swing you could head to the practice area for a while to get it tuned and grooved before heading back out on the course again. Confidence in your swing will have to be built to stop you second guessing your shot making and cure your fear of the pond.

Best Wishes DrSwing
